reference_images.usage: Race proportions only: head-to-torso ratio, pointed ears, slim hips and limbs. Design a completely different scout, clothes, weapon and kneeling pose.

description: Draw ONE complete standing-ground combat enemy on transparency for a side-view native pixel-art game. The character faces screen LEFT with eyes, muzzle and front foot pointing to the left edge. Ground both feet or knee naturally. Leave transparent margin around weapon, head and soles. Strong 1px dark contour and simple readable native-size clusters with top-left light from the rendering reference. A lean adult elf expedition ranger in a very low half-kneel, left foot planted well forward, one knee almost on the ground, preparing an arrow at the side of a short diagonally lowered recurved bow. Show the bow down and in front, no drawn shot. Slender elf arms, long ears outside short black windswept hair with ochre headband. Distinct outfit: long split-tail indigo Guild riding coat over a honey-ochre jerkin and green sleeve cuffs, leather thigh quiver and split boots. Head and face left, torso in side three-quarter profile. Make a strong diagonal from rear shoulder down to bow tip. Adult elf proportions, no hood, no military helmet.

reference_images.usage: Human proportions, head/limbs and Guild livery only. New adult, visibly heavier torso, entirely different stance and equipment.

Low diagonal shield-wall pose. Wears a dark indigo long split gambeson, a short ochre shoulder mantle over one dull iron pauldron, mail at elbow and stout greaves. Bare head, no dome helmet; compact broad torso, human leg/arm lengths.
